'''Trinkets''' are pan accessories that grant bonus perks.

To equip a '''Trinket''', open your [[Prospector Kit]], go to '''Pans''', and underneath the [Equipped] button, you will find an orange button that says "'''Trinket: None'''" (or the name of your previous trinket if you already had one equipped for that pan).
